nestjs.title: NestJS - A progressive Node.js framework
nestjs.description: NestJS is a framework for building efficient, scalable Node.js web applications. It uses modern JavaScript, is built with TypeScript and combines elements of OOP (Object Oriented Programming), FP (Functional Programming), and FRP (Functional Reactive Programming).

sqlite.title: SQLite
sqlite.description: A small, fast, self-contained, high-reliability, full-featured SQL database engine.

typeorm.title: TypeORM
typeorm.description: TypeORM is an ORM that can run in NodeJS, Browser, Cordova, Ionic, React Native, NativeScript, Expo, and Electron platforms and can be used with TypeScript and JavaScript.

docker.title: Docker: Accelerated Container Application Development
docker.description: Docker is a platform designed to help developers build, share, and run container applications. We handle the tedious setup, so you can focus on the code.

coolify.title: Coolify - Self-hosting with superpowers
coolify.description: Self-hosting platform with superpowers. Deploy apps, databases & 360+ services to your server. Open-source alternative to Heroku.

ovhcloud.title: OVHcloud VPS
ovhcloud.description: Virtual private servers from a European cloud provider, with root access and unlimited traffic.

jwt.title: JSON Web Tokens - jwt.io
jwt.description: JSON Web Token (JWT) is a compact URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred between two parties. The claims in a JWT are encoded as a JSON object that is digitally signed using JSON Web Signature (JWS).

easyweek.title: EasyWeek
easyweek.description: Online booking and scheduling for beauty, wellness and other appointment-based businesses.

google-maps.title: Maps Embed API
google-maps.description: Easily embed and customize Google Maps on your web page or blog by setting the Google Maps Embed API URL.

react.title: React
react.description: React is the library for web and native user interfaces. Build user interfaces out of individual pieces called components written in JavaScript. React is designed to let you seamlessly combine components written by independent people, teams, and organizations.

nextjs.title: Next.js by Vercel - The React Framework
nextjs.description: Next.js by Vercel is the full-stack React framework for the web.

udemy.title: Udemy
udemy.description: An online learning platform with video courses on programming, design, business and more.

spring.title: Spring
spring.description: Level up your Java code and explore what Spring can do for you.

thymeleaf.title: Thymeleaf
thymeleaf.description: A modern server-side Java template engine for both web and standalone environments.

html.title: HTML: HyperText Markup Language | MDN
html.description: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the most basic building block of the Web. It defines the meaning and structure of web content. Other technologies besides HTML are generally used to describe a web page's appearance/presentation (CSS) or functionality/behavior (JavaScript).

css-subgrid.title: Subgrid - CSS | MDN
css-subgrid.description: The CSS grid layout module includes a subgrid value for grid-template-columns and grid-template-rows. This guide details what subgrid does and gives some use cases and design patterns that the feature solves.
